verdict.rationale: Smooth is a hosted browser-agent service, so self-hosting is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence documents a way to self-host the core product. The GitHub repo is a client SDK/CLI, and the "self" P2P tunnel only routes traffic through the user's IP. Community comments ask for self-hosting and note the product is not running on users' own machines, which points to its absence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
